title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-006
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence and news clippings regarding the FAA's release of information on the 1986 Japan Air Lines UFO sighting, interspersed with unrelated personal notes and religious/conspiracy-themed writings.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines flight 1628 cargo jet shadowed by two belts of light and a huge spaceship while crossing into Alaska.
incidents.explanation: Investigator Philip J. Klass concluded the pilot was seeing an unusually bright image of Jupiter and possibly Mars.
incidents.quote: JAL Capt. Kenjyu Terauchi reported on Nov. 17 that his Boeing 747 cargo jet was shadowed by two belts of light
